Command.Statement: WITH MEMBER [Measures].[Name] AS [Store].CurrentMember.Name MEMBER [Measures].[Caption] AS [Store].CurrentMember.Caption MEMBER [Measures].[Promotion] AS [Promotions].CurrentMember.Caption SELECT {[Measures].[Name], [Measures].[Caption], [Measures].[Promotion]} ON 0, Head([Store].[Store Name].Members, 3) ON 1 FROM [ZFMSALESCP] WHERE [Promotions].[0000000001]
